    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    AccessModifier
    The ELM access modifier: who may see a definition.
    DateTimePrecision
    The ELM date time precision: how fine a date or time comparison is.
    ElmCanonical
    The canonical text of a node: its kind and its members with the members sorted by name and every plain value written the same way whichever form it came from.
    ElmCatalog
    The ELM node catalog read back from the store: every node kind, its base, and its positions with what each holds, how many, and in which form (IKE-Network/ike-issues#1110).
    ElmCatalog.EnumerationValue
    An enumeration of the catalog: the position holds one of its value concepts.
    ElmCatalog.ExternalValue
    A type of another schema the catalog names but does not describe.
    ElmCatalog.Form
    How our vertex holds a position: as a property, or as an edge to a vertex below.
    ElmCatalog.KindValue
    A node kind of the catalog: the position holds a node of this kind or of a kind that extends it.
    ElmCatalog.NodeKind
    A node kind of the catalog.
    ElmCatalog.PositionRule
    One position of one node kind: what it holds, how many times, and in which form.
    ElmCatalog.PrimitiveValue
    A primitive the schema language supplies, such as string or boolean.
    ElmCatalog.ValueType
    What a position may hold.
    ElmConformance
    Checks one of our trees against the ELM node catalog: every vertex a known node kind, every property and every edge a position its kind allows, held in the allowed form, the allowed number of times, holding a value or a node of the allowed kind.
    ElmConformanceException
    A tree does not conform to the ELM node catalog: a vertex is not a known node kind, holds a position its kind does not allow, holds it in the wrong form, holds it too few or too many times, or holds a value of the wrong kind.
    ElmDocument
    An ELM library as a document, the one shape both readers produce and the exporter writes (IKE-Network/ike-issues#1112).
    ElmDocument.Definition
    One definition of the library.
    ElmDocument.Node
    One ELM node.
    ElmDocument.NodeBuilder
    Builds nodes member by member, in document order.
    ElmExporter
    Writes a library back out of the store as a document: the identity record, every active definition in its container, ordered lists unfolded into their items, and roles first, second, and third folded back into the operand list.
    ElmIdentity
    Identity for what a library becomes, derived and never random (IKE-Network/ike-issues#1110).
    ElmImporter
    Imports an ELM library document into the running store (IKE-Network/ike-issues#1112): the library concept, one definition semantic per definition, ordered lists where order carries meaning, and a reference semantic for every distinct thing a definition names, a quantity's unit among them: a CQL calendar word means IKE's unit of time, a UCUM code the unit's own concept or a composed unit made on demand (IKE-Network/ike-issues#1114).
    ElmImporter.Report
    What an import did.
    ElmImportException
    A document cannot be imported: a name it uses cannot be resolved, a member is not one its kind allows, or a library it includes is not in the store.
    ElmJsonReader
    Reads ELM in its JSON form, as the translator writes it: a node is an object whose type names its kind, its other members are positions, and a list is an array.
    ElmJsonWriter
    Writes a document in ELM's JSON form, as the translator does: a node is an object, its type written when the position it fills allows more than one kind, its members in catalog order, a list as an array.
    ElmLibraryWriter
    Records a library as knowledge (IKE-Network/ike-issues#1110, #1112): one concept for the library, one tree semantic per definition about that concept, each definition carrying its name as a description in the CQL dialect, ordered list semantics where order carries meaning, and one reference semantic per thing a definition names.
    ElmNode
    One ELM node as it is being built: its kind, the plain values it holds by position, the nodes it holds by position, the roles first, second, and third, and the ordered lists it points at.
    ElmNode.Argument
    A node held under a position or a role.
    ElmTreeBuilder
    Builds one of our trees from ElmNodes, driven by the catalog: a vertex per ELM node, properties for the plain values it holds, an argument vertex between a node and each node it holds, and a list reference where a position's items live in an ordered list semantic.
    ElmTypeNames
    The two spellings of a System type: the qualified name ELM writes, in the braces form, and the catalog's concept for it (IKE-Network/ike-issues#1113).
    ElmXmlReader
    Reads ELM in its XML form, as the translator writes it: a node is an element, its kind on xsi:type when the position allows more than one kind, plain values as attributes and held nodes as child elements.
    ElmXmlWriter
    Writes a document in ELM's XML form, as the translator does: a node is an element, its xsi:type written when the position it fills allows more than one kind, plain values as attributes, held nodes as child elements, and qualified type names re-prefixed from the braces form with the namespaces the document declares.
    SortDirection
    The ELM sort direction.
